sentences.back: Medicine is changing quickly because doctors want to find the best way to help patients.
In the past, doctors would give everyone with the same illness the same pill.
Today, a new idea called personalized medicine helps doctors look closely at a person's body.
By studying genetics, doctors can see how a person's body will react to a certain drug.
This special science is called pharmacogenomics.
When doctors use this information, they can choose a safer, just-right drug treatment for one specific person, stopping bad side effects before they start.
